item.title: Pressure grows for Venezuela's authoritarian regime as opposition leader Machado returns
item.description: Maria Corina Machado's return to Venezuela presents a fresh challenge for Trump-backed President Delcy Rodríguez and reignites questions over the prospect of new elections.

item.description: Wisconsin is enjoying its first Major League Baseball championship since the Milwaukee Braves took the title in 1957.

item.title: Trump returns to South Carolina as Senate race tightens
item.description: President Trump returned to South Carolina - the second time in eight days. The amount of attention and money its U.S. Senate race is getting is raising questions about how red the state really is.

item.title: Russia hosts African leaders at summit, as major powers compete for influence
item.description: As Russia hosts African leaders, it's making a pitch for influence, security partnerships and access to the continent's mineral wealth. But China and the U.S. are also vying for Africa's favor.

item.description: Cases and controversies from President Trump's aggressive immigration are making their way to the Supreme Court this term, with several more disputes percolating on the emergency docket.

item.description: Candy companies are responding to increase in cocoa costs this year with creative combinations that use less chocolate. Despite higher prices for candy, consumers are still spending on Halloween.
